mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which signals a potential economic slowdown and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strong demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals an economic contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 is negative for two consecutive quarters.
